profile.headline: Software Engineer | Peopleshores x Accenture |Building Innovative Solutions
profile.summary: My path into software engineering is built on a diverse background in electrical work, IT, and independent consulting. These experiences strengthened my problem-solving skills, systems thinking, and ability to approach technology from a practical perspective. Today, I’m focused on software development, with growing interests in AI, integrated platforms, and technology consulting. I enjoy using both my technical skills and real-world experience to build meaningful solutions that solve problems and create lasting value.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: I contribute to React-based development and translation/localization projects within a financial environment, collaborating through team meetings and project discussions while continuing to strengthen my full-stack development skills. Beyond my daily responsibilities, I expand my expertise in AI and emerging technologies through independent projects, professional certifications, and networking, bringing new knowledge and stronger problem-solving skills to my work.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Engineering · Java · React.js · Spring Boot · JavaScript · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Bootstrap (Framework) · Postman API · TypeScript · Software Design

positions.title: Cable Puller
positions.description: I Assisted with pulling and lacing fiber-optic cable to support network infrastructure installation. Worked alongside team members to complete assigned cabling tasks while maintaining an organized and professional work environment.

positions.title: Installation Technician
positions.description: Provide on-site IT infrastructure and field installation support involving LAN/WLAN configuration, Ethernet and structured cabling, network-connected printers, POS hardware, Power over Ethernet (PoE), IP surveillance cameras, and smart-safe systems. Conduct technical site surveys, install and configure network-connected equipment, troubleshoot connectivity and hardware issues, and support reliable deployment of technology solutions across customer environments.

positions.title: AWS Datacenter Technician
positions.description:
Assembled, disassembled, and repaired computer systems and components to maintain operational efficiency.

Diagnosed and resolved hardware and network issues in the datacenter, including the installation and replacement of a wide range of components such as RAM, storage drives, and power supplies.

Managed and closed support tickets using Boost, applying effective troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Installed and configured workgroups, provided remote desktop assistance, and ensured proper access permissions for users and groups.

Troubleshot and managed network devices, including routers, switches, wireless access points, and wireless extenders.

Configured security settings and access permission to maintain compliance and protect systems.

Analyzed and reported computer network security issues to enhance infrastructure resilience
positions.insights: Skills: Domain Name System (DNS) · Network Services · Ticketing Systems · Network Infrastructure
